sophie-cs: FYI AcmePay reported a production break after the last rollout — their payment items array is missing the `metadata` field for items after index 3. Their parser fails (KeyError) and this started immediately after the rollout. P1 from customer.

sophie-cs: Example payload they sent (expected):
```json
{
  "payments": [
    {"id":"p1", "amount":100, "metadata":{"method":"card"}},
    {"id":"p2", "amount":200, "metadata":{"method":"bank"}},
    {"id":"p3", "amount":150, "metadata":{"method":"card"}},
    {"id":"p4", "amount":120, "metadata":{"method":"card"}},
    {"id":"p5", "amount":80,  "metadata":{"method":"bank"}}
  ]
}
```

sophie-cs: What they get back after the rollout (actual):
```json
{
  "payments": [
    {"id":"p1", "amount":100, "metadata":{"method":"card"}},
    {"id":"p2", "amount":200, "metadata":{"method":"bank"}},
    {"id":"p3", "amount":150, "metadata":{"method":"card"}},
    {"id":"p4", "amount":120},
    {"id":"p5", "amount":80}
  ]
}
```

marc-eng-runtime: Can you paste the request_id, route, and model variant? Also did they hit a specific shard or region? Any example logs from our side for req id would help.

sophie-cs: Request id `req_0a9f7c3b`, route `/v1/generate`, model `gptx-1.3-quant-v2`. Customer on us-east-1. They say it only happens when payments.length > 3. I have the customer's schema validator stacktrace: `KeyError: 'metadata'` referencing item index 3 and 4.

deploy-bot: Canary -> prod rollout completed at 2026-03-15T14:35:12Z (build: 2026.03.15-8842).

anita-eng-ml: Hmm. Two quick hypotheses: 1) structured-output post-processor got a change that prunes repeated object fields after a certain token window, 2) batching/prefix cache interaction with quantized kernels truncating token spans when arrays get long.

anita-eng-ml: Can you share the prompt + inputs (redacted) or repro curl? I'll try to reproduce locally with the same model/quantization.

sophie-cs: Repro curl they gave (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-1.3-quant-v2","prompt":"<customer prompt>","max_tokens":256,"input":{"payments": [ ... 5 items ... ]}}'
```
Customer says rolling back to the previous build fixed it for them.

ryan-ops: Marc, can you confirm if any kernel/quant patch was included in this rollout? If so we should consider an immediate revert while we investigate. Customer is on a paid SLA, and CS flagged P1.

marc-eng-runtime: I'm pulling the serving logs for req_0a9f7c3b now. Early note: there was a change to the structured-output sanitizer in the release — toggled stricter field pruning when predictions include repetitive object lists. I'll check the exact commit. If customer sees rollback fixed it, we should flip the flag or roll back the release.

marc-eng-runtime: Opening incident INC-2026-1023 and assigning to eng-runtime + eng-ml. I'll attach the logs once I have them.

sophie-cs: Incident INC-2026-1023 created. Customer wants a rollback if no fix in 30m. Account team notified. :eyes: :phone:
